{{Top|leg}}
'''Shadow crowns''' were headpieces worn by [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]. They were made of a mineral called [[Nihil smokestone]] that gave them the ability to act as a mental transmitter and receiver. Sorcerers used these crowns to control [[Pawn|Pawns]] that had been imprinted with smokestone. When a Sorcerer wore a shadow crown, they gained the ability to receive the collective sensory input of their Pawns. Only a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] could use a shadow crown, but any being could be influenced by it assuming they had smokestone implants or cranial harnesses.<ref name=":0">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

[[Blessed Toxmalb]] wore a shadow crown buried beneath his skin that could control up to a hundred Pawns.<ref name=":0" />

Former Sorcerer of Rhand [[Cronal]] crafted his own shadow crowns out of [[meltmassif]] from the planet [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], and wore a transmitter crown called the "[[Cronal's Shadow Crown|Sunset crown]]".<ref>''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
